The reception staff are so trained in the medical field they apparently no more than the doctors even before an appointment due to super human body scanning skills while over the phone.  This places Practice Manager is just beyond trying to reason with, who ignores the concerns of patients to save face with her abrupt reception colleagues.   My mother died a year and a half ago from Septic Shock as she had Leukemia.  My mother was fobbed off over and over again as this pathetic practice, well they would not request or carry out relevant tests each time my mother attended the practice, there for it was to late once it was diagnosed! (The doctor in question, well she no's who she is) who let my mother down as she called up over and over again' checking in' most likely worried about a lawsuit!  It's a real shame her husband left the practice as he did his job properly.   I had to argue for six months for a scan for my back after I landed in A&E with sever back pain and temporary paralysis.  Turned out however, I had two Herniated Disks in my lower spine.  My daughter had from what I can gather Flu A before Christmas.  This left her with sever pain breathing in from her left side, she was also coughing up fluid.  She attended an appointment and low and behold no scan or referral for any investigation (What a surprise) Go the walk in she was told for when needing a second appointment, despite the walk in not having the equipment to test for the problem at hand.
They will not refer for investigation without a battle of wits, risking further and prolonged sickness or in my poor mothers case - Death!

When I was finally seen during my time here, the doctors seemed rushed and uninterested in listening to my concerns complaining over appointment timeframes.  The examination felt superficial, and I left with no clear answers or helpful advice. To make matters worse, I had difficulty getting my test results and had to follow up multiple times. Overall, this was one of the worst healthcare experiences I've ever had.
